title: Choose the VÉRANE visual world
question: Every card keeps your pinned palette (forest, champagne, ivory, espresso), Cormorant + a refined sans, the VÉRANE / PARIS wordmark and your home-page sections. They differ in the world the site is built from. Keep the roll, take the pick, take your brief straight, or re-roll.

options.label: The Maison Swatch Book
options.lineage: A Paris leather house's bound sample book: cut leather chips on ivory pages, each with a name and reference number.
options.thesis: The whole site reads as VÉRANE's swatch book: every colour is a real leather chip you touch to see the bag in it.
options.viewport: A full-screen photograph with 'Véritablement vôtre'. Along its foot sits a strip of leather chips (Noir, Cognac, Bordeaux, Crème) that are working colour links into the shop, next to [Discover the collection].
options.risk: It needs colour-variant photos to feel rich. With one colour per bag today, the chip strip is short until the photos arrive.

raised.raise: Total material commitment: forest cloth owns whole bands (the Paris · India band and the footer), never as accent stripes.
Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: huge Cormorant against tiny tracked labels, with no icon tiles or ornament.
Addressable catalogue: every style carries a maison reference (Réf. 021) on cards, swatches and invoices.
Front and back: a product card's 'Détails' turns it over to a ruled spec sheet (dimensions, what fits, leather).
Honest absence: a sold-out colour stays in the swatch row as an empty chip marked 'Back soon', never hidden.
Making shown in stages: the Crafted in India band follows one bag through cut, stitch, edge-paint and finish.

options.label: Rue Vitrine
options.lineage: A Paris boutique front: forest-painted wood, gilt hand-lettering on glass, one bag lit in the window.
options.thesis: The site is the shopfront on a Paris street. You stop at the window, read the gilt sign, and step inside.
options.viewport: The hero photo sits inside a painted forest frame like a shop window. 'VÉRANE · PARIS' is gilt above it, and the tagline and [Discover the collection] are lettered on the glass.
options.risk: The most familiar 'Parisian' idea, close to what many boutiques ship. The frame must stay architectural, not a picture of a shop.

options.label: Mesophotic Deep Dive
options.lineage: technical dive profiles down a reef wall
options.thesis: The page as a descent through depth stages.
options.viewport: A vertical dive axis with a depth readout.
options.case: Loses both: shoppers don't identify with diving, and the depth axis hides the bags.
options.risk: A cold, technical world against a warm leather brand.
options.kept: Total material commitment: forest owns whole bands.

options.label: Hand-bent Neon
options.thesis: Typography as one continuous lit glass stroke.
options.viewport: A dark room with a lit script word.
options.case: Loses both: flashy, nocturnal, and against 'not flashy'.
options.kept: Making shown in stages (cut, stitch, edge-paint, finish).

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: A giant letter morphing under a slider.
options.viewport: One huge glyph and an axis slider.
options.case: Loses both: a designer's toy, and nothing about bags.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone, no ornament.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The catalogue as numbered broadcast pages.
options.case: Loses both: retro-tech novelty against quiet luxury.
options.kept: Every style gets an addressable reference number.

options.label: Wax Pack Cards
options.thesis: Products as collectible cards with stat backs.
options.viewport: A dealt stack of portrait cards.
options.case: Loses both: sporty collectible energy against the maison.
options.kept: Card front and back: the portrait turns over to a ruled spec sheet.

options.label: VHS Rental Wall
options.thesis: Browse spines by genre; absences tagged.
options.kept: Honest absence: sold-out colours stay visible as 'Back soon'.

canonCard.label: Your brief, played straight
canonCard.thesis: The luxury e-commerce standard, done impeccably: full-bleed hero, centred serif tagline, clean product grids.
canonCard.viewport: A full-screen photo with a centred 'Véritablement vôtre' and [Discover the collection], with the sections below exactly as listed in your brief.
canonCard.risk: Close to many premium Shopify themes by design; it relies entirely on photography quality, which is the weakest asset today.
